hero.title: Eternal University
hero.summary: Eternal University at Baru Sahib is a women’s university governed by The Kalgidhar Trust. Agriculture teaching sits within Dr. Khem Singh Gill Akal College of Agriculture, established in 2014. Its course material spans crop, soil, horticultural and food-related sciences in a residential university setting.

overview.heading: Women’s agriculture education at Baru Sahib
paragraphs: Eternal University is based in the Baru Valley of Himachal Pradesh and is governed by The Kalgidhar Trust. Its registration portal explicitly restricts programmes to female applicants. This is a material admission condition for families considering agriculture at the university.

Dr. Khem Singh Gill Akal College of Agriculture was established within the university in 2014. The college’s published curriculum covers agronomy, horticulture, soils, crop improvement and protection, livestock production and food-related subjects. It also publishes laboratory manuals and a named academic roster. Applicants can assess how these subjects connect to their goals while confirming the current practical timetable, residential costs and entry-year eligibility directly.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture is the undergraduate agriculture programme identified in the university’s 2026–27 listing. The college curriculum covers crop, soil, horticultural and allied sciences; a current explicit duration statement was not captured.
programmes.eligibility: The undated Akal College of Agriculture table gives 10+2 Agriculture orPCB/PCM/PCMB with 50% aggregate,40% forSC/ST/physically challenged categories, and age 16 by 1 July. The newer programme chooser did not reliably match its displayed criteria to this agriculture record during recheck; obtain the intended-intake prospectus before relying on a category threshold.
programmes.admission_route: Apply through the official university portal; current selection and document rules must be confirmed from the 2026–27 prospectus.

fees.includes: Published first-semester programme fee; includes the page’s₹5,000 one-time refundable caution-money note.
fees.note: Undated official amount, not a verified 2026–27/2027 quote. The fee table lists BSc(Hons)Agriculture₹45,600 for the first semester and₹40,600 from the second semester onward, with₹5,000 one-time refundable caution money noted. Hostel, mess and a complete current charge statement need separate confirmation.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to EU
admissions.intro: The registration portal states that all programmes are for female aspirants and refers to the 2025–26 and 2026–27 sessions. Confirm the current eligibility table before applying: the indexed 2026–27 page and older college page give different reserved-category thresholds.
eligibility_points: The official registration portal limits programmes to female aspirants.
The 2026–27 listing names Agriculture, PCB, PCM and PCMB school pathways with the stated aggregate conditions.

campus.heading: Agriculture resources within the Baru Sahib campus
campus.intro: The college publishes laboratory manuals in protected cultivation, machinery, soil-and-water conservation and related subjects. University navigation also identifies apiary, vermicompost and food-quality-control units; current student access and capacity should be checked.

facilities.name: Agriculture learning resources
facilities.description: The college page provides laboratory-manual links covering practical agricultural subjects.

practical_learning: The university identifies agricultural learning units including apiary and vermicompost resources.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: Eternal’s published tuition-concession page contains a 2024–25 policy for newly admitted undergraduate and postgraduate students. It uses qualifying marks to set a first-semester tuition concession and separately describes certain family/category waivers. The session is historical; applicants need the policy for their intended intake.

schemes.name: Historical 2024–25 first-semester merit tuition concession
schemes.details: The published 2024–25 matrix gives 75% tuition concession for 95%and above,50% for 90–below 95,30% for 80–below 90, and 10% for 70–below 80, in the first semester for new UG/PG admissions, subject to the stated fee-payment condition. This is not a current-session scholarship promise.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The university provides a Training and Placement Cell link. No dated agriculture cohort outcome table was verified, and individual alumni comments are not used as employment statistics.

faqs.question: Can male applicants apply for agriculture at Eternal University?
faqs.answer: The official registration portal states that all university programmes are exclusively for female aspirants.

faqs.question: Which college teaches agriculture?
faqs.answer: Dr. Khem Singh Gill Akal College of Agriculture, established within Eternal University in 2014.

faqs.question: Who governs the university?
faqs.answer: The official sponsoring-organisation page identifies The Kalgidhar Trust.

faqs.question: Why should category thresholds be reconfirmed?
faqs.answer: The 2026–27 listing shows 45% for the named reserved categories, while the older college page shows 40%. Obtain written confirmation of the applicable rule.

faqs.question: Does the ICAR row cover every agriculture postgraduate course?
faqs.answer: No. The audited university row explicitly lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture for 19 July 2022 to 18 July 2027. Other offerings need separate accreditation evidence.

faqs.question: Is the published first-semester fee a current-session quote?
faqs.answer: Eternal’s undated fee table lists B.Sc.(Hons.)Agriculture at₹45,600 for the first semester and₹40,600 from the second semester onward, with a₹5,000 refundable caution-money note. Its intake-year applicability is not established, so obtain a dated offer before budgeting.

faqs.question: Which scholarship or support information is published for EU?
faqs.answer: Eternal’s published tuition-concession page contains a 2024–25 policy for newly admitted undergraduate and postgraduate students. It uses qualifying marks to set a first-semester tuition concession and separately describes certain family/category waivers. The session is historical; applicants need the policy for their intended intake. The published 2024–25 matrix gives 75% tuition concession for 95%and above,50% for 90–below 95,30% for 80–below 90, and 10% for 70–below 80, in the first semester for new UG/PG admissions, subject to the stated fee-payment condition. This is not a current-session scholarship promise.

faqs.question: Which learning facilities are documented at EU?
faqs.answer: Agriculture learning resources: The college page provides laboratory-manual links covering practical agricultural subjects.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for EU?
faqs.answer: https://portal.eternaluniversity.edu.in/register. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.

faqs.question: How can applicants contact EU?
faqs.answer: Public telephone: +91 9816640660; Public email: admissions@eternaluniversity.edu.in. These are institutional contact details, not an Agrico admissions guarantee.
